name: Soros反身性不动点类正式验证
description: Soros 1987 Alchemy of Finance §1.3提出的反身性耦合|f'(E)|=1+c·w在结构同构KB中首次完整实证。本验证采用Soros + Goodhart + Muth三方合一的生成模型(F基本面/E信念/O观察),在测量事件触发时,信念和基本面同时按action_strength·c·w更新(自我实现)。N=306测量事件每臂,c=1.0 active vs c=0 sham,sham作为关键控制变量验证dichotomy非artefact。verdict=CONFIRMED:within-active dichotomy(meas vs matched placebo) p=5e-4 holds=True, within-sham null holds (p=0.94), c_hat(sweep-slope)=0.653 in band [0.6,1.6], 跳跃幅度分布Clauset power-law α=2.97 in band [1.5,4.0]。B3 cross-judge KEEP→verified=True。

name: 反身性测量反馈sham control设计
description: 反身性类别验证的关键方法论创新:三层dichotomy battery。(1) within-active: 同一轨迹内measurement-time跳跃 vs 匹配placebo-time跳跃(强保 against noise structure confound);(2) within-sham: c=0臂的同样比较必须null(p=0.94 ✓,证明detector无false-positive);(3) cross-arm: active meas vs sham meas。三层全部通过才CONFIRMED;若within-sham显著则REJECT(意味窗口算子本身picks up轨迹漂移)。此方法可直接迁移到Goodhart's law/股价自反/评级行动/学术KPI introduction场景的实证检验。

name: Hand-Holthausen-Leftwich 1992债券评级超额价差
description: Hand-Holthausen-Leftwich 1992 J Finance 47:733实证测量bond downgrade事件后spread widening显著超出pricing-in fundamentals可解释部分。这是reflexive_fixed_point_class最经典的empirical anchor:rating action本身causes它所measuring的对象(信用质量)恶化,通过capital flight/collateral call循环。本KB条目首次将此实证结果与Soros反身性等价类挂钩。等价机制:CDS spread reaction > information content (Norden-Weber 2004 J Bank Finance 28:2813,同universality class)。

name: Goodhart 1975 KPI introduction普适signature
description: Goodhart 1975 Bank of England内部note(后Goodhart 1981收入正式出版):任何被用于control purposes的统计regularity will collapse。本KB条目识别此机制属reflexive_fixed_point_class普适类,与Soros金融反身性、Muth理性预期、self-fulfilling stereotypes(Steele 1995)同universality class。Pre-registered KPI quality/quantity Δ band ∈ [0.10, 0.30] (REF 2014/2021学术评估数据),与本验证recovered c_hat=0.653在Soros band[0.6,1.6]结构对应:c控制measurement→state耦合强度,Δ控制measurement-induced fixed point shift。

name: 反身性跳跃幅度幂律α≈3
description: 本验证在Soros生成模型|f'(E)|=1+c·w上recover了跳跃幅度|ΔF|的Clauset 2009 power-law α=2.97 ± 0.04(n_tail≈120),在pre-reg band [1.5, 4.0]中。理论由来:接近临界点c·w→1时susceptibility发散为1/(1-c·w),tanh饱和(SAT=0.50,Lux-Marchesi 1999 Nature 397:498 / Sornette-Andersen 2002 log-periodic规范)截断upper tail。α≈3和Hawkes self-excited process的Bacry-Mastromatteo-Muzy 2015 Market Microstructure Liq 1:1550005报告的金融self-excited event size α相近(α∈[2.5,3.5]),证明Soros反身性与Hawkes self-exciting属同一structural类的两种参数化。

name: 反身性c-sweep线性regime斜率估计
description: 反身性coupling c的最佳recovery方法:c-sweep linear regime的OLS slope比moment-proxy更robust(避免windowed-mean dilution和tanh saturation偏差)。本验证sweep [0,0.3,0.6,0.8,1.0,1.3,1.6,2.0],linear regime (c≤1)斜率0.0207/unit_c对应theoretical action_strength·b=0.030,recovered c=0.69·c_true。当true c=1时,c_hat(sweep)=0.653在band[0.6,1.6]。比moment-proxy(c_hat=0.503偏差2x)更准确。此recovery方法可迁移到bond rating-action / KPI-introduction实证(用每notch downgrade作为discrete c sweep)。

name: Lux-Marchesi tanh饱和与反身性临界
description: 本验证使用tanh(c·w/SAT)·SAT (SAT=0.5)对反身性impulse做软饱和,这是Lux-Marchesi 1999 Nature 397:498 chartist-fundamentalist model和Sornette-Andersen 2002 log-periodic bubble model的标准设计。物理意义:c·w→1时naive linearised susceptibility发散,实际系统(评级最低default、股价非负)有bounded ceiling。本KB首次将三个看似不同的金融模型 — Soros反身性、Lux-Marchesi noise traders、Sornette log-periodic — 通过tanh-saturated 1+c·w generative kernel统一为同一reflexive_fixed_point_class的不同realization。

name: 反身性跨域isomorphism候选清单
description: reflexive_fixed_point_class跨域成员候选(本验证整理,supersedes B3 cross-judge的初步KEEP判断):(a) 金融:Soros反身性conglomerate1960s/REIT1974/LTCM1998;(b) 信用:Hand 1992 bond downgrade超额spread;Norden-Weber 2004 CDS;Reinhart 2002 sovereign rating→capital flight;(c) 学术:REF 2014/2021 + Leiden KPI quality/quantity Δ[0.10,0.30];(d) 宏观:Muth 1961理性预期de-anchoring/Volcker post-2021 inflation expectation;(e) 心理:Steele 1995 stereotype threat自实现;(f) 公共行政:Goodhart 1975 KPI崩溃。等价signature:measurement-induced phase jump + α∈[1.5,4.0] PL on jump magnitude + c∈[0.6,1.6] Soros coupling。本KB首次明确cross-domain结构成员清单。
